name: search-refused-without-code
description: A problem document with no code raises refusal_without_code with the class its status maps to, and keeps its body's retryable and trace_id, so a retryable false 503 is not retried and its trace id is the body's, not the header's.

origin.edit: A 503 problem document with no code, retryable false and trace_id 11111111111111111111111111111111 answers the search, with x-dfo-trace-id 22222222222222222222222222222222.
